decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +2.1% and S&P 500 +1.9% mark a clear risk-on day, so we're deploying the remaining cash into our three open slots rather than holding idle. We picked AUGO, SEZL, and ASST — all score-95 candidates with RSI in the healthy 55-70 bullish zone (not overbought) plus confirmed MACD crossovers and rising momentum. Existing positions are untouched; stop-losses and profit targets will handle those automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today pushed both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 higher by roughly 2%, with risk appetite returning across growth and momentum names. This kind of synchronized move across major indices typically reflects improving sentiment on macro conditions (rates, earnings, or economic data) rather than a single stock-specific catalyst. Smaller-cap momentum names with strong technical setups, like today's top-scored candidates, tend to benefit most from this kind of broad risk-on flow.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現強勁,納指及標普500指數同步上升約2%,反映市場風險偏好明顯回升,資金重新流向增長股及動力股。這種多個主要指數同步上揚的情況,通常反映整體宏觀氣氛改善(例如利率預期或經濟數據向好),而非單一股份的消息刺激。在這種全面「風險偏好」(risk-on)氛圍下,具強勁技術形態的中小型動力股往往受惠最多。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that stocks moving strongly in one direction tend to keep moving that way for a while. Traders confirm momentum using indicators like MACD (trend direction) and RSI (strength without being overextended), which is exactly how today's buy candidates were selected.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動力投資(Momentum Investing)是指買入已經處於明顯上升趨勢的股票,背後邏輯是強勢股份在短期內有機會延續升勢。投資者通常會用MACD(趨勢方向)及RSI(力度但未過熱)等技術指標來確認動力是否真實,今日所選的買入標的正是以此方法篩選出來。
